name: Bazooka Bubble Water Gun |  Bubble Blaster Toy for Kids | Outdoor Fun
description:
Make playtime exciting with the Bazooka Bubble Water Gun, designed to blow hundreds of bubbles in seconds. Lightweight and easy to hold, it features a A4 battery for endless fun without constant replacements. Built from safe, non-toxic ABS plastic, it’s durable and kid-friendly. With 36 bubble outlets and built-in lights, it’s perfect for parties, outdoor play, and unforgettable family moments.
Key Features:
 Blows out hundreds of bubbles per minute
 Made with safe, non-toxic ABS plastic
 Lightweight, durable & easy to use
 Perfect for kids, toddlers, and outdoor fun
 Ideal for parties, picnics, beach days & celebrations
How to Use:
 Charge the bubble gun fully before use
 Add bubble solution to the tray provided
 Dip the bubble outlet into solution
 Press the trigger to release bubbles
Ingredients/Material:
ABS Plastic
Safety Information:
 For children above 3 years only
 Use under adult supervision
 Do not overfill with liquid solution
 Keep away from fire and high heat
Package Includes:
 1 × Bazooka Bubble Water Gun
 1 × Bubble Solution Tray
